record.context_brief: Categorical Torelli questions for quartic threefolds
record.original_question: For quartic threefolds, is there a categorical Torelli theorem, and does a birational categorical Torelli theorem hold?

evidence.quote: Question 5.36. Is there a version of the Categorical Torelli theorem for quartic threefolds? Does the birational Categorical Torelli theorem hold for quartic threefolds?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth quartic threefold, i.e. a smooth hypersurface of degree $4$. Its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves admits the semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(X),\, \mathcal{O}_X,\, \mathcal{O}_X(1),\, \mathcal{O}_X(2),\, \mathcal{O}_X(3)\rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is defined as the right orthogonal complement
$$\mathcal{K}u(X) := \langle \mathcal{O}_X,\, \mathcal{O}_X(1),\, \mathcal{O}_X(2),\, \mathcal{O}_X(3)\rangle^{\perp} \subset D^b(X).$$

Address the following two questions for smooth quartic threefolds.

(a) (Categorical Torelli.) Let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be two smooth quartic threefolds in $\mathbb{P}^4$. Suppose there exists a $\mathbb{C}$-linear exact equivalence $\mathcal{K}u(X_1) \simeq \mathcal{K}u(X_2)$ (of Fourier–Mukai type). Does it follow that $X_1 \cong X_2$ as projective varieties? Identify, if necessary, the minimal additional hypotheses on the equivalence (or on $X_1$, $X_2$ in a general position sense) under which this implication holds.

(b) (Birational categorical Torelli.) Under the same hypothesis that $\mathcal{K}u(X_1) \simeq \mathcal{K}u(X_2)$, does it follow that $X_1$ and $X_2$ are birational over $\mathbb{C}$?
artifact.status_search_result: Surveys on categorical Torelli theorems list quartic threefolds as a case where neither the categorical Torelli theorem nor the birational categorical Torelli theorem has been established; results are known for nearby cases (cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, Gushel–Mukai threefolds, del Pezzo threefolds of degree 2–4), but the quartic threefold case appears to remain open as of 2024–2025 surveys.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing established categorical Torelli theorems (cubic threefolds, quartic double solids, GM threefolds, del Pezzo threefolds) and outstanding open cases.
status_evidence.claim: Quartic threefolds are not listed among the cases with established categorical/birational categorical Torelli theorems.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes categorical and birational categorical Torelli results for GM threefolds; references neighbouring cases.
status_evidence.claim: The categorical Torelli problem for quartic threefolds is mentioned as a related open direction.
